structure.structure_en: Living room, rectangular, deeper than wide, 3 m x 3.8 m; ceiling 2.7 m; floor: light beige square ceramic tiles laid in a straight grid, continuous level plane, no steps. Left window 1.5 x 1.5 m, sill 0.9 m, 35% along the wall. Right window 2 x 1.6 m, sill 0.9 m, 50% along the wall. Camera 1.5 m high, 3.8 m to the far wall, 24 mm lens, tilt -2 degrees, horizon 45% of frame height. The number of openings is exactly 2; do not add or remove any opening. Opening proportion: the opening covers about half the wall with solid wall on both sides. Fixed features that stay: ceiling cornice: plain stepped plaster cornice running along all wall-ceiling junctions; skirting board: low dark reddish-brown tile skirting at the floor line; left window sash grid: pale timber frame with rectangular multi-pane mullion layout; right window sash grid: pale timber frame with regular rectangular mullion grid and frosted lower panes; installed ceiling fan: white three-blade ceiling fan mounted at the centre of the ceiling.
structure.structure_en_model: The room is a narrow rectangular living room, deeper than wide, with a flat plain white ceiling at about 2.7 m and a continuous level floor of light beige square ceramic tiles laid in a straight grid. Each side wall is a single flat white painted plane finished with a low dark reddish-brown tile skirting and a plain stepped plaster cornice at the ceiling junction. The far wall is solid with no openings. The left wall carries a pale timber multi-pane grid window on a 0.9 m sill, and the right wall carries a larger pale timber rectangular-mullion grid window with frosted lower panes on a matching sill. A white three-blade fan is fixed at the ceiling centre. The camera sits at 1.5 m in one-point perspective straight at the far wall with a slight downward tilt.
